snippet.title: Lair of the Leviathan Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Have you heard the tale of the Leviathan?” they all ask. From curious peasants on lonely goat trails to old sages around the hearth. Always the same question when you’re travelling through the world of Ormande.

Lair of the Leviathan is an open world RPG that aims to capture the best parts of classic RPGs of the past where you lead a party of heroes as you fight your way through a large, completely hand crafted open world with challenging turn based combat and deep RPG mechanics.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752020/Lair_of_the_Leviathan/ 
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/lair_of_the_leviathan
